// why this file exists: Vite walks up from a source file looking for the nearest tsconfig.json. Without
one here it finds the repository root's, which extends astro/tsconfigs/strict.
Astro is a dependency of the ROOT package, not of this sub-site, so that extends
cannot resolve and the build fails (voltip/tsconfig.json has the measured case).
This file stops the upward walk at the sub-site boundary, which is also the
correct scope: lockra/ is deliberately not part of the root workspace.
